rows.TEXT: I'll have them ready for the front lines in no time!
Business is always good in times of war.
They look a little sloppy, I can probably fix that for you.
Look closer, you'll see we sell more than just animal feed.
We've picked up a few items of interest from travelers such as yourself.
We'll make them work for you! Money up front.
They're ugly, but effective. Don't look at its eyes!
My school of magic will help you to move about the land unseen while slowing your pursuers.
I can help you deflect harmful spells.
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.

Sentry 
"Sollem lies ahead. It is a haven for noble Elves. If we seek their aid, we will no doubt lose the aid of the savage Elves south in Dawnshallow. It is a difficult choice."

Sentry 
"We near Dawnshallow, home to the savage Elves of this region. Should we make contact with them, we will be shunned by the northern Elves of noble Sollem. We must decide."

Fyrwenn 
"Illumielle has asked us to seek your help! We rally the Elves of Nevendaar in the name of Gallean. He has returned, and he has work for us to do. We move towards Temperance to reclaim forests given to us long ago."

Hilo'och 
"Hah! Temperance? You move against a human stronghold? What mad voices are you hearing in your heads that would guide you towards your own destruction?"

Fyrwenn 
"I've told you...we've received instructions from Gallean himself! Your god and your queen demand your cooperation. Surely living so far from your homeland has not corrupted your loyalty!"

Hilo'och 
"Nor my sanity. Prove your claims, woman. Show us a miracle. Return this small region to the Elves! No? Then we will remain hidden in these dark days and let the world destroy itself."

Gelliwyn 
"You young fool! Don't you recognize her? She obviously shares blood with the queen herself. If you need proof, I will join them and bring you proof. Her word is good enough for me."

Tora'ach 
"Brothers...we've been called to the hunt! Gallean moves us towards war against Temperance! Fetch your bows and we'll be on our way!"

Velech 
"Do you think we're that dim? Temperance has long been a symbol of peace between our people and the Empire. We may not support that peace, but we're not fit to face an army in battle. Take your mad ideas elsewhere."

Tora'ach 
"Did you not hear me? You have no choice! Your god and your queen demand your services!"

Velech 
"And where is your proof? You look like a ragged bunch to me..."

Menelles 
"Can't you see he tells the truth? No, I suppose not...you've resigned yourselves to living as simple forest thugs. Just wait, Gallean will help us take back these lands and we will return to collect you and your soldiers."

Gelliwyn 
"There are large crystals in these lands, rumored to be the first tears of Solonielle that struck Nevendaar's surface. Take me to them. Gallean willing, I may be able to use them to help us expedite our task."
Convert 45% of the land to Elven terrain and return Gelliwyn to Sollem.

Gelliwyn 
"Ah...yes, here it is. Beautiful, isn't it? I should be able to channel my meager power through it...let's hope it works."

Gelliwyn 
"Gallean, give me the strength to do this!"

Gelliwyn 
"Ah yes! That will do nicely!"

Gelliwyn 
"Disgusting that these beasts have built their cities around such a sacred relic. Perhaps if I focus hard enough we can clean up some of their filth."

Fyrwenn 
"Apparently Gallean still watches over you, Gelliwyn!"

Menelles 
"The forests of this region have dwindled...we'll need to change that. Surely they will  not ignore such a miracle. Solonielle's first tears to strike Nevendaar still remain in this region. Take me to them. Let us see what Gallean will do."
Convert 45% of the land to Elven terrain and return Menelles to Dawnshallow.

Hilo'och 
"Begone! You have the stench of Dawnshallow with you! We do not speak with garbage."

Velech 
"My scouts have seen you conspiring with the filth from Sollem. You'll get no help from us."

Menelles 
"Ah...here it is. More beautiful now, it seems, than when I first beheld it. If Gallean is indeed with you, let's see if he's willing to help me use it."

Menelles 
"And that's that. Quickly, we must move out of enemy territory."

Menelles 
"Disgusting to see such a holy thing buried in the middle of such a demonic place. Perhaps we can change that..."

Menelles 
"Let's see what can be done. It's awful cold out here."

Menelles 
"There. That ought to warm things a bit."

Gelliwyn 
"Hilo'och! Look around you. Do you see? Gallean has returned these lands to us! Are you a believer now?"

Hilo'och 
"Yes...I have been watching your progress. I only hope the queen will forgive me my skepticism. We will move to Temperance and prepare for war. I don't understand why, but I cannot argue with the miracles I have seen."

Fyrwenn 
"Do not be ashamed. We are all confused, but we move with purpose. We hope to see you in battle, Hilo'och...and do your best to survive it. We have much to discuss about reuiniting our people when this has passed."

Hilo'och 
"Yes...we will meet again. There is a chance I may not encounter your army again before you siege Temperance. We will be fighting back the Humans who remain in this region. Take this..."

Hilo'och 
"You may give this to the noble Elf tribe near Temperance so that they will not make the same mistake I did. They will join you in your conflict without question."

Drullia'an 
"Thank you. We must leave now. The Humans have no doubt alerted Temperance to our presence. We've no time to waste."

Vellech 
"Old man, you've done it! I am astounded!"

Menelles 
"It wasn't my doing, it was Gallean, as this lad tried to explain to you before. Are you willing to join us now? As you can see, there's plenty of forest to mask our travel."

Vellech 
"Yes, of course, we were only being cautious. Of course we will follow Gallean's will. My men are preparing to leave at once, but just in case we are unable to reunite near Temperance, here is something that may help you..."

Vellech 
"Show this to the wild Elves near Temperance and they will not give you the trouble I gave you. They will provide aid without question. We will leave at dusk, I suggest you do the same. The Humans will retaliate soon."

Tora'ach 
"Let them. What does it matter if we slay them one day or the next?"

Tora'ach 
"Look how thick the forests grow! This must be enough to convince those cowards to join us! We should return to them quickly!"

Millu 
"...and then he showed me our future city, one we have owned before. We shared this sanctum with the Humans, but we were not allowed free passage through its halls. We were not allowed to speak on its so-called "peace council."

Millu 
"We toiled to build its walls, but never owned them! The city is Temperance! The great symbol of peace between our races rots from within! They never valued us, they simply needed our services - and when finished, we were discarded! No longer!

Millu 
"No longer will any people who wrong us go unpunished! No longer will we hide among the leaves while the world passes us by! We existed before the Dwarves or Humans ever touched Nevendaar, yet we succumb to their rules?"

Tora'ach 
"To Temperance! We will take back the city! We will take back our pride!"

Illumielle 
"I have to admit, it is good to see Tora'ach back among us. Our archers seem in such better spirits when he is leading them. I only hope he ha...why is it snowing? This is the wrong seaso-"

Valkyrie 
"Villainous Elves! We bring the wrath of Wotan to cut out your sinister hearts! The songs of war will drown your cries for help! Come forward and face us with honor!"

Dwarf Champion 
"Did you ever hear of a Dwarf who couldn't dig? You bought yourselves a small bit of time, is all!"

Tora'ach 
"You heard them! They wish to fight! Toss me a quiver and let's put an end to this interruption!"

Illumielle 
"We must find the Elven tribes in this region, we are growing weaker. We will never make our way to Temperance with the numbers we have."

Tora'ach 
"After the Dwarves are finished, we will begin the search for the Elven cities. There are thousands of Elves hidden within these forests. Sollem should be an easy find, but Dawnshallow may prove difficult."

Illumielle 
"Millu, what's wrong? I've never seen you cry before."

Millu 
"I just don't understand why Gallean wills this. I know many of the Humans we will soon face in battle. I fought beside King Emry as he liberated my family from Mortis. Many of my closest friends will die - on both sides...and for what?"

Illumielle 
"You of all people should know...you're his voice! He simply wants to give us back what we deserve. I don't always agree with his methods, but it is not my place to question them. Do you doubt that the words you speak are his, Millu?"

Millu 
"No. It is Gallean. How he must have suffered -  to have so much rage within him. That is why I cry."

Engineer 
"Elves! Don't come any closer or we'll unleash the beast!"

Engineer 
"We did warn you...we were hoping to wait until he had calmed down, but maybe he will after he's eaten. OPEN THE GATE!"

Tora'ach 
"Isn't a gate rather pointless when the beast has wings anyway?"

Grovemaiden 
"They seem to have weak control of it with runic magic. It will probably charge us instead of the Dwarves."

Millu 
"No! Something is not right! The sage! We must protect the sage!"

Millu 
"No! Something is not right! The sage! We must protect the sage!"

Fyrwenn 
"Mortis has given the Dark Elves their own keep. This used to be Sollem, home to noble Elves. They must have fled this foul place."
"Or were slain and rose to serve her."

Dark Elf Butcher 
"Brothers...why take our home away from us? You'll all be a part of our...new family...so enough. Hahahahah!"

Fyrwenn 
"The stench in these halls is making me naseous. Let's hurry on..."

Tora'ach 
"Look how thick the forests grow! This must be enough to convince those cowards to join us! We should return to them quickly!"

Tempest Giant 
"Such a long, long life. It is my time to return to Wotan."
"This one still draws breath. It is cruel to leave them half slain, do you want to shame Gallean?"

Fyrwenn 
"Do you feel it too? The...presence...is so strong. Perhaps we should avoid that farmhouse."

Dwarf 
"Hoarfang has already been released! We've lost this city!"

Tora'ach 
"Get back! These aren't statues! Something has turned them into solid stone!"
"The beast was keeping this in the depths of its mine. It won't restore the long-petrified victims, but perhaps it will aid us against the Humans."

Illumielle 
"What? How did you get past our archers? Guards!"

Thief 
"Leave us alone and we'll do the same."

Illumielle 
"He seemed sick..it's true, then. The demons must be slowly dying. It sounded like a weak attempt at a truce; they'd never offer unless they were in a dire situation. This is interesting..."

Illumielle 
"We'll use it to our advantage. It seems that they will not attack us for the time being, and we have enough enemies to consider as it is. When we are ready to focus on the Legions, we will simply break our 'understanding' and finish them."

Watchman 
"Certainly the demons expect us to be afraid of them. They will think we stay allied for our own protection."

Tora'ach 
"Do you hear the chanting? Is there a monastery in these woods?"

Watchman 
"No. Listen...there's something else in there. Those aren't chants of the righteous."

Forest Liege 
"We had no idea there were still Griffins alive in there. We'd never seen a den go mad like the ones hatched from that aviary.  We thought we had killed them all."

Forest Liege 
"We shouldn't have entered that Volary. Griffins are only loyal to their masters and they must have seen us as a threat. Such a waste..."
"Such a tragedy. An ancient and noble creature such as this, answering to  the commands of the half-men. We should not pride ourselves in slaying it."

Succubus 
"You look weary. Come in, travelers. I'm sure there's some way we can ease your aching bodies."

Grovemaiden 
"Don't listen to her! She is trying to enchant you!"

Elder Vampire 
"Look at your faces. You think you've accomplished something, do you? I am but one of thousands."

Trapper 
"The tribes will have your heads for this!"

Tora'ach 
"The tribes will never find your bodies. When we are finished, it will seem as though you simply vanished. We'll suffer no retribution from your kind."

Elder One 
"You're very small. They said you'd come. They didn't say you were small. There is no glory in smashing the small."

Tora'ach 
"She's smiling! Why is she smiling? What are the Clans planning?"
